limits: Synthetic continuity fixture is isolated from user data; real bundled backend and settings actions, no substituted API responses.
Native acceptance covers macOS arm64 only; it is not Windows/x64 acceptance or the full release acceptance matrix.
Ad-hoc local signature; no notarization or Gatekeeper distribution claim.
GitHub CI is tracked separately at the final PR head.
Shared cursors describe each inspected page; receipts deliberately do not claim an entire database has complete historical coverage.
